Beginner.learningGoal: Write a module table, return it, and use require with caching.
gotchas: require caches by name in package.loaded, so a second require returns the same table
A module that forgets to return M gives true
Global assignment instead of local leaks into the environment
goodSolutionShows: Tests proving module identity across requires
shapeHints: a counter module whose state is shared by all requirers

Intermediate.learningGoal: Structure multi-file modules with init.lua, dependency injection and package.loaded.
gotchas: Circular requires get a partially loaded module or loop
Clearing package.loaded[name] is needed to reload in tests
package.path order decides which file wins
goodSolutionShows: Lazy require inside functions to break cycles
Dependencies injected rather than required globally
shapeHints: a plugin with core, util and init modules
injecting a logger into a module
a lazy-loaded optional dependency with a fallback

Advanced.learningGoal: Design module APIs with versioning, lazy submodules and sandboxed environments.
gotchas: Lazy submodule via __index calls require once and caches on the table
Environments for sandboxing differ between 5.1 (setfenv) and 5.2+ so the guide forbids them
goodSolutionShows: package.preload used to provide fake modules in tests
shapeHints: a fake module injected through package.preload
a registry module with explicit reset for tests
